alt: Brain lobes in detail (Blausen). Each lobe color-coded with functional cortex highlighted - primary motor cortex (frontal, precentral gyrus), primary somatosensory cortex (parietal, postcentral gyrus), primary auditory cortex (temporal), primary visual cortex (occipital).
